Under the hood is the same new A20 Pro chip that appears across Apple’s latest iPhones. The iPhone Duo also has a C2 modem for 50% faster uploads. [...] There’s now a foldable iPhone. The iPhone Duo folds in half to fit in your palm or unfolds so you can view and use two apps at once.
